ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets, several pieces with firm, bumpy tops and pale green stems, roughly 2-4 cm across each, slightly glossy surface, sitting at the top-left of the plate | 45
ITEM 2 | Small loose green floret fragment, about 1 cm, bright green, near the broccoli pieces | 2
ITEM 3 | Slice of pizza-style flatbread at upper right, roughly 10 cm long and 4 cm wide, golden-brown crust edges, melted pale cheese with browned spots, red-orange tomato or pepperoni-like topping pieces, slightly oily sheen, partly overlapping the greens | 60
ITEM 4 | Shredded leafy greens (romaine-like) dressed with a creamy pale dressing, dark green and pale yellow-green leaves, wilted and glossy, pieces about 3-6 cm, covering roughly a quarter of the plate in the lower right, with visible white creamy coating and flecks of grated cheese | 75
ITEM 5 | Creamy pale white dressing coating the greens, thick, clinging to leaves, sitting directly on and among the salad leaves | 15
